entries: It feels so peaceful here. I love it!

City life seems like it would be
really nerve racking...

No surprises, no stress--
that is the secret of a good life!

Pokémon are the same! They prefer to
live in a natural setting, too.

Here, everyone is pleasant and kind
to everyone else.{VAR BE01}
I want to work with everyone
for the sake of this incredible forest!

Guess what?
Check this out!{VAR BE01}
A Pidgey was eating food
in the grass right over there!

What can I say?
White Forest is too dull.{VAR BE01}
It doesn't have enough hustle and bustle
to keep a guy like me interested.

Aaaaaaaeeeeeeeek!
Is that a Gastly over there?{VAR BE01}
Oh, whew. It's just your shadow.
But I have seen a Gastly recently.

Ohhhhhhh, am I bored! So bored!
I want to go back to Black City!

Gosh. Maybe I've become too calm...
'Cause I'm bored now!{VAR BE01}
But that's worth feeling, too,
from time to time.

Wait, what?
A Togepi just ran behind you right now!

Karenna: Keep going! Yeah!
My Pokémon and I are running!{VAR BE01}

So, I've had a lot of fresh air,
and I think I'm well refreshed!{VAR BE01}
I have a lot of other work to do,
so I want to go to Black City.

Recently, I saw a Shinx in this area!
Yes, just being here refreshes me!

Well, you know, I was born and raised in
the city, so maybe I should go home soon.

Recently a Magby was staring at me from
over there!{VAR BE01}
It ran as soon as our gazes met.
If it likes me, it should let me know!

I'm good and refreshed, so I
want to go back to Black City.

People are drawn to man-made things.
I miss Black City...

But, hmmm... I think it's about time
to head somewhere else.

This is a pretty place, but maybe
a little boring...

Oh, that's right! An Azurill was running
happily toward the grass!{VAR BE01}
Maybe I should run with the Pokémon
in the grass!

Well, my Pokémon is having fun, but
I'm starving for some excitement.

Just a second ago, my Pokémon was
playing with a wild Budew.{VAR BE01}
It ran away when it saw me, but
it really looked like it was having fun!

But I'm a little tired of being out in
the countryside.{VAR BE01}
I want to spend time in a place where
there is more stuff.

Gene: My hobby is meeting Pokémon
in their natural habitat!{VAR BE01}

I spent today with a Bellsprout!
It was a precious experience!

Shane: Here both Pokémon and
people can just be themselves.{VAR BE01}

But I'm worried about how this
more honest me will be seen.

I just saw a Rhyhorn over there!
A Rhyhorn in its natural state... Wow!

But I also think I want to promptly
be able to show people how I feel!

Eliza: When you encounter nature,
your heart becomes that much richer.{VAR BE01}

I saw a Trapinch, and it made
my heart happy.

Business opportunities don't just come
rolling at you so easily.{VAR BE01}
Ahh... I feel like Black City may be a
better fit for me...

But now I'm thinking I'd rather think
about just one thing very deeply.

But I want to study something
with a more clear, definite answer...

Rosa: Watching the growth of nature lets
you feel some kind of growth every day.{VAR BE01}

Every day of being alive means many small
changes that give the day meaning.{VAR BE01}
I thought that when I saw
a Whismur recently.

Herman: Living here, surrounded by
nature, is very calming.{VAR BE01}

But it's not like me to stay
in one place forever.

Emi: It's fun to travel as you like, with
no particular goal in mind.{VAR BE01}

But maybe it's better to have at least
some idea of where you're going?

In my travels through this forest, I met
a Happiny! I was so happy!

Grace: The beauty created by nature...
Its grandness exceeds human imagination.{VAR BE01}

The beauty of the Bagon I just saw was
natural and good...

entries.text:
White Forest
People and Nature in Harmony
